ValidationRule.description: Medical specialty fields are only valid on Medical Professional (HCP) person accounts.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName <> "SDO_PersonAccounts", OR( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Specialty_1__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Specialty_2__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Specialty_3__c))), NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Specialty_4__c))) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Specialty fields can only be set on Medical Professional (HCP) accounts.
